parts.title: Word List
parts.content:
Detailed Meanings

💡
bomb[bɑm]n.
A bomb is an object that explodes and destroys large areas.
→ The bomb will destroy anything that is near.
💡
certificate[sərtifəkit]n.
A certificate is a document that says that something is true or happened.
→ I was given a certificate after completing the computer course.
💡
circumstance[sə:rkəmstæns]n.
A circumstance is an event that makes a situation what it is.
→ There were many circumstances behind their success like hard work.
💡
coffin[kɔ:fin]n.
A coffin is a box used to bury dead people.
→ When a person passes away, they are usually buried inside of a coffin.
💡
cope[koup]v.
To cope with a difficult or stressful situation means to deal with it.
→ He copes with work stress by exercising three or four times a week.
💡
criticism[kritisizəm]n.
Criticism is the act of saying that you don’t like or approve of something.
→ She had a lot of criticism about their new plan.
💡
devastate[devəsteit]v.
To devastate something means to completely destroy it.
→ The entire wall was devastated.
💡
frown[fraun]v.
To frown is to make an unhappy look with your face.
→ Melissa frowned when she found out that the party had been cancelled.
💡
gaze[geiz]v.
To gaze at something means to look at it for a long time.
→ We used a telescope to gaze at the stars for over an hour.
💡
glance[glæns]v.
To glance at something means to look at it quickly.
→ She glanced behind her to see if he was looking at her.
💡
grief[gri:f]n.
Grief is the feeling of deep sadness, usually when a person dies.
→ The grief caused by losing her parents was very difficult for her.
💡
groom[gru:m]n.
A groom is a man who is going to be married.
→ The groom looked happy as he walked with his new wife.
💡
license[laisəns]n.
A license is an official document that gives one permission to do something.
→ In the United States you need a driver’s license to drive legally.
💡
microscope[maikrəskoup]n.
A microscope is a device that makes small objects look bigger.
→ Germs cannot be seen without a microscope.
💡
nuclear[nju:kliər]adj.
When something is nuclear, it relates to the division or joining of atoms.
→ Nuclear power plants provide inexpensive energy to cities.
💡
portray[pɔ:rtrei]v.
To portray something means to describe it or show it in a picture.
→ Her picture portrayed the house she grew up in when she was little.
💡
rotate[routeit]v.
To rotate something means to turn it around in a circle.
→ An airplane’s propellers rotate quickly to help it fly.
💡
souvenir[su:vəniər]n.
A souvenir is something you buy to remind you of a place or event.
→ I bought a Russian doll as a souvenir from my trip to Moscow.
💡
submarine[sʌbməri:n]n.
A submarine is a boat that can go underwater for long periods of time.
→ The submarine dove under the sea so the enemy couldn’t see it.
💡
trace[treis]v.
To trace something means to follow over it with the eyes or a finger.
→ He traced over the graph with his finger.

sections.title: Exercise 1: Part A. Choose the right word for the given definition.

questions.content: to show in a picture
questions.explanation: portray có nghĩa là khắc họa, miêu tả trong tranh ảnh.

questions.content: something that causes an event
questions.explanation: circumstance là hoàn cảnh, tình huống dẫn đến sự việc.

questions.content: a feeling of sadness
questions.explanation: grief là nỗi đau buồn sâu sắc.

questions.content: a box for burying dead people
questions.explanation: coffin là quan tài.

questions.content: a device for making small things look bigger
questions.explanation: microscope là kính hiển vi.

sections.title: Exercise 1: Part B. Choose the right definition for the given word.

questions.content: certificate
options: something bought to remind of a place
a document that claims a fact
questions.explanation: certificate là giấy chứng nhận.

questions.content: cope
options: to deal with a difficult situation
to turn around in a circle
questions.explanation: cope có nghĩa là đương đầu, đối phó với tình huống khó khăn.

questions.content: trace
options: to look at for a long time
to follow over with the eyes
questions.explanation: trace có nghĩa là lần theo bằng mắt hoặc ngón tay.

questions.content: groom
options: a boat that can go under water
a box used to bury dead people
a man about to be married
questions.explanation: groom là chú rể (người đàn ông sắp kết hôn).

questions.content: bomb
options: the act of finding fault with someone
a feeling of sadness because of death
questions.explanation: bomb là quả bom (vật phát nổ).

sections.title: Exercise 2: Choose the word that is a better fit for each blank.

questions.content: 1. The engineer ________ a line with his finger to where he thought the police officers would find the ________. (traced / bomb)
questions.explanation: Kỹ sư dò theo (traced) một đường bằng ngón tay đến nơi có quả bom (bomb).

questions.content: 2. The politician said that there were many ________ that led to the US using a ________ weapon on Japan. (circumstances / nuclear)
questions.explanation: Có nhiều hoàn cảnh (circumstances) dẫn đến việc sử dụng vũ khí hạt nhân (nuclear).

questions.content: 3. I was so busy that I could only ________ at my daughter’s ________ of achievement. I will take a better look at it when I get home. (glance / certificate)
questions.explanation: Quá bận nên chỉ có thể liếc nhìn (glance) tờ giấy chứng nhận (certificate) thành tích.

questions.content: 4. The entire family was filled with ________ as their father’s ________ was slowly lowered into the ground. (grief / coffin)
questions.explanation: Cả gia đình tràn ngập nỗi đau buồn (grief) khi quan tài (coffin) được hạ xuống.

questions.content: 5. I was completely ________ when I heard the news of her accident. I hope that her husband can ________ with the situation. (devastated / cope)
questions.explanation: Hoàn toàn suy sụp (devastated) khi nghe tin và hy vọng chồng cô ấy có thể vượt qua/đối phó (cope).

questions.content: 6. Maria ________ her ________ so that all of her classmates could get a good view of it. (rotated / souvenir)
questions.explanation: Maria xoay tròn (rotated) món quà lưu niệm (souvenir) để cả lớp cùng xem.

questions.content: 7. After receiving a great deal of ________ about her idea, Katie ________, but was determined not to quit. (criticism / frowned)
questions.explanation: Sau khi nhận nhiều lời chỉ trích (criticism), Katie cau mày (frowned) nhưng quyết không bỏ cuộc.

questions.content: 8. Tony ________ at the pictures of the new forms of bacteria that were discovered. Curious, he viewed samples of them through a powerful ________. (gazed / microscope)
questions.explanation: Tony nhìn chằm chằm (gazed) vào bức ảnh và quan sát mẫu vật qua kính hiển vi (microscope).

questions.content: 9. Eric did not have a ________ to operate the sophisticated ________. (license / submarine)
questions.explanation: Eric không có giấy phép (license) để vận hành tàu ngầm (submarine).

questions.content: 10. Lisa ________ her new ________ as the perfect husband. But we all knew that he had many faults. (portrayed / groom)
questions.explanation: Lisa miêu tả (portrayed) chú rể (groom) mới của mình như một người chồng hoàn hảo.

parts.title: Comprehensive Reading
parts.content:
An Interesting Life

A man looked through some boxes with his grandson. They were filled with old photographs and objects that portrayed important events from the grandfather’s life. He wished to share the circumstances behind each event with his grandson.

The grandson, however, thought his grandfather’s stories were boring. The grandfather coped with this. He ignored his grandson’s criticism.

He took a photo from the box. “That’s the submarine I was on during the war,” he explained. The grandson gazed at it.

The grandfather glanced at the next picture and frowned. It showed a row of coffins. His grandson noticed the grief in his grandfather’s face.

“What is it?” the boy inquired.

“This was after a nuclear bomb was dropped,” the grandfather answered. “It devastated a city.”

Next the grandfather pulled a toy microscope from the box and rotated it in his hand.

“Where did you get that?” the grandson asked.

“This is a souvenir I bought at the science museum,” the grandfather said.

Now the boy was really interested. He started to understand that his grandfather was telling him a larger story. It was the story of his grandfather’s life.

He got another photo. It showed a young bride and groom. They were very happy. A certificate was attached to the photo. The boy couldn’t read it, but he traced his finger over the paper.

“What’s this from, Granddad?” he asked.

“That’s my marriage license from the day I married your grandmother,” the grandfather said.

“Wow!” said the boy. “Granddad, now I know all about your life!”
parts.translation:
Một Cuộc Đời Thú Vị

Một người đàn ông đang cùng cháu trai xem lại vài chiếc hộp. Chúng chứa đầy những bức ảnh cũ và những kỷ vật khắc họa các sự kiện quan trọng trong cuộc đời người ông. Ông muốn chia sẻ hoàn cảnh đằng sau mỗi sự kiện với cháu trai mình.

Tuy nhiên, cậu cháu trai lại nghĩ những câu chuyện của ông thật nhàm chán. Người ông đối phó với điều đó bằng cách phớt lờ những lời chê bai của cháu.

Ông lấy một bức ảnh từ trong hộp ra. “Đó là chiếc tàu ngầm mà ông đã phục vụ trong thời chiến,” ông giải thích. Cậu cháu trai nhìn chăm chú vào bức ảnh.

Người ông liếc nhìn bức ảnh tiếp theo và cau mày. Bức ảnh chụp một hàng quan tài. Cậu cháu trai nhận thấy nỗi đau buồn trên gương mặt ông.

“Đây là gì vậy ông?” cậu bé hỏi.

“Bức ảnh này chụp sau khi một quả bom hạt nhân được thả xuống,” người ông trả lời. “Nó đã tàn phá hoàn toàn cả một thành phố.”

Tiếp theo, người ông lấy một chiếc kính hiển vi đồ chơi từ trong hộp ra và xoay nó trên tay.

“Ông mua cái đó ở đâu vậy ạ?” cậu cháu trai hỏi.

“Đây là món quà lưu niệm ông mua ở bảo tàng khoa học,” người ông đáp.

Lúc này cậu bé đã thực sự thích thú. Cậu bắt đầu hiểu rằng ông mình đang kể cho cậu nghe một câu chuyện lớn hơn. Đó chính là câu chuyện về cuộc đời của ông.

Ông lấy ra một bức ảnh khác. Bức ảnh chụp một cô dâu và chú rể trẻ tuổi. Họ trông rất hạnh phúc. Một giấy chứng nhận được đính kèm với bức ảnh. Cậu bé không đọc được chữ trên đó, nhưng cậu lần ngón tay theo từng nét chữ trên tờ giấy.

“Tờ giấy này là gì vậy ông?” cậu hỏi.

“Đó là giấy phép kết hôn từ ngày ông cưới bà của cháu,” người ông nói.

“Chà!” cậu bé reo lên. “Ông ơi, giờ thì cháu đã biết tất cả về cuộc đời của ông rồi!”

sections.title: Part A: Mark each statement True or False.

questions.content: The photographs portrayed important events from the grandson’s life.
questions.explanation: Đoạn 1: 'portrayed important events from the grandfather’s life' (cuộc đời của người ông chứ không phải người cháu) -> Sai (False).

questions.content: The grandfather explained that the picture of the coffins was taken after a nuclear bomb devastated a city.
questions.explanation: Đoạn 6: 'This was after a nuclear bomb was dropped... It devastated a city.' -> Đúng (True).

questions.content: The first photo the grandson gazed at was of a submarine.
questions.explanation: Đoạn 3: '“That’s the submarine I was on during the war,” he explained. The grandson gazed at it.' -> Đúng (True).

questions.content: The toy microscope was a souvenir from a science museum.
questions.explanation: Đoạn 9: 'This is a souvenir I bought at the science museum' -> Đúng (True).

questions.content: The certificate was from the day the grandson was born.
questions.explanation: Đó là giấy đăng ký kết hôn ngày ông cưới bà ('from the day I married your grandmother') -> Sai (False).

questions.content: The groom and bride in the last photo were happy.
questions.explanation: Đoạn 11: 'It showed a young bride and groom. They were very happy.' -> Đúng (True).

questions.content: Which of the following was NOT in the box?
questions.explanation: Trong hộp có ảnh (photographs), quà lưu niệm (souvenir), và giấy đăng ký kết hôn (marriage license), không có những bức thư (Letters).

questions.content: What did the grandfather say he did during the war?
questions.explanation: Đoạn 3: 'That’s the submarine I was on during the war.'

questions.content: How did the grandson feel at first about the circumstances behind each photograph?
questions.explanation: Đoạn 2: 'The grandson, however, thought his grandfather’s stories were boring.'

questions.content: All of the following are true about the toy microscope EXCEPT ________.
options: the grandfather rotated it in his hand
the grandson only glanced at it
the grandfather bought it at a museum
questions.explanation: Cậu cháu trai rất hứng thú và hỏi ông mua nó ở đâu, chứ không phải chỉ liếc nhìn qua ('the grandson only glanced at it' là sai).
